scope: mechanical identification, grade separation, and sale comparison

workflow.title: Identify source
workflow.instruction: Record whether aluminum comes from heat sinks, housings, castings, sheet, wire, radiators, or mixed assemblies.

workflow.title: Check attachments
workflow.instruction: Inspect for steel screws, copper tubing, plastic, thermal pads, and other contamination that can change buyer grade.

workflow.title: Separate grades
workflow.instruction: Keep clean extrusion, cast, sheet, aluminum wire, heat sinks, and mixed/dirty aluminum separate where buyer categories justify it.

workflow.title: Remove easy contamination
workflow.instruction: Mechanically remove accessible steel, plastic, or copper attachments only when the grade improvement exceeds the labor cost.

workflow.title: Weigh fractions
workflow.instruction: Record clean and mixed weights separately for Scrap Radar pricing and yield comparison.

workflow.title: Time-value check
workflow.instruction: Compare upgraded grade value with labor minutes before repeating the cleaning process across a batch.
